rows.abstract: \"Omnibus Housing and Urban Development Act of 2007\".  The bill creates the Department of Housing and Urban Development to supervise urban planning, development and renewal, including land use and zoning, housing and finance. It also deals with the 4 aspects of land and housing development: finance, production, regulation and administrative structure.

With their inclusion in the ambit of RA 53, journalists can not be compelled to reveal the source of a confidential news report or information except when a court or or committee of Congress finds that the revelation is demanded for the security of the State.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE VENUE OF THE CRIMINAL AND CIVIL ACTION IN LIBEL CASES AGAINST COMMUNITY JOURNALISTS, PUBLICATIONS OR BROADCAST STATIONS
rows.title_short: Providing For The Venue Of The Criminal And Civil Action In Libel Cases Against Community Journalists, Publications Or Broadcast Stations
rows.abstract: Under the present rule on venue, the complainant, if he is a public officer, can file the complaint in Manila if his office is in Manila or in the office outside Manila if his office is located there. This rule on venue has placed community journalists and local broadcasters in a situation where they have to answer complaints filed, rightly or wrongly, in distant places, diliberately filed far away from their place of work. The bill seeks to provide a specific venue of action in libel cases against a community journalist, community publication or community broadcast station.

rows.abstract: \"Strengthening and Enhancing the Use of English as the Medium of Instruction Act\". rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING CERTAIN PARCELS OF LAND OF THE PUBLIC DOMAIN WITHIN SMALL ISLANDS AS AGRICULTURAL LAND OPEN TO DISPOSITION FOR COMMERCIAL ECO-TOURISM AND OTHER PRODUCTIVE PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Declaring Certain Parcels of Land of the Public Domain Within Small Islands as Agricultural Land Open to Disposition for Commercial Eco-Tourism
rows.abstract: The bill declares as agricultural lands certain parcels of land of the public domain within small islands with land areas of 50,000 hectares or less, already devoted to or with great potential for eco-tourism ventures.  These lands shall be open to disposition for commercial eco-tourism purposes provided that they have been subjected to a public cadastral survey.

rows.abstract: \"Student Loan Program Act\".  The bill establishes a Student Loan Program to provide financial assistance to qualified applicants. It prescribes the requirements, procedures and terms and conditions for the availment of the student loan.
rows.status: Referred to Stakeholders on 2009-04-14

committee_action.meethigh: Referred to CHED and TESDA for position paper.

rows.author: D053
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING CERTAIN PROVISIONS OF EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 18, CREATING THE SUGAR REGULATORY ADMINISTRATION
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to empower the Sugar Regulatory Administration to declare any excess importation of sugar over consumer needs as 'reserve' in order to balance local production with consumer demand and keep the prices of sugar constant.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE & FOOD since 2007-07-30

rows.author: D024
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 10(1) AND SECTION 11 OF REPUBLIC ACT 7156 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 'MINI-HYDROELECTRIC POWER INCENTIVE ACT'
rows.abstract: The bill provides for 60% of the special privilege tax collected from mini-hydroelectric power developers to be remitted directly to the host local government unit as its share and for the remaining 40% to be remitted to the national government.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2007-07-30
